capabilities: Pull generated markdown notes from the server's inbox into a vault folder
Push vault filenames and tags to the backend as LLM context
Switch and validate LLM providers with API keys or a local Ollama URL
Point Archivist, Analyst, and Synthesist modes at local prompt template files
Authenticate to the backend with a bearer token from its web dashboard
disambiguation: Not a standalone web clipper; it only exchanges notes and vault context with its companion self-hosted Add To Vault backend.
extras: Code was primarily written by Google Gemini Pro under human direction. Not yet in the official community plugin directory, so manual installation from GitHub releases is required. Only filenames and tags are uploaded to the backend, never file contents.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture web articles, have them summarized by an LLM you control, and receive the resulting notes with links based on your existing vault.

relations.evidence: Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Kimi, or Ollama

account on the backend's web dashboard
LLM provider API key or local Ollama URL

summary: Companion plugin that pulls LLM-summarized article notes from a self-hosted backend and pushes a vault filename index as LLM context.
